@graph.comment:
Inventory record: PHP-0932
Evidence status: Maintainer-reported backport availability
Deployment status: Not assessed
PHP version scope: 5.6.40-47.3.el6.local for CentOS 6.10 i686 only
Limitations: 33 PHP binary RPMs and one source RPM. The October minimal backport from Anton Barinov is combined with Remi security patches and local allocation/lifecycle corrections. Focused Apache/FPM and LDAP checks passed in the supplied report. Full suites retain 55 NTS/CGI, 48 ZTS and 11 FPM failures. Regression failures remain unresolved. No general production-readiness or dependency-security claim is made. Both builds disable session upload progress. OOM can terminate a worker without application cleanup. PHP and CentOS are EOL. Inclusion does not establish NCSC endorsement or eliminate unrelated vulnerabilities.
Patch owner: PHP and upstream backport authors for the source fixes. Artem Loboda for the community integration and release.
CVE assessment limit: The fixedIn entries record the maintainer-provided backport for each named RPM build, based on linked source and reports. Complete exploit coverage has not been demonstrated.
Source accessed: 2026-10-31
